stops.note: sharp, acid, describing the taste of acids this element was thought to form
coined by Lavoisier from Greek oxys (sharp) and -gene (producer), believing the element was essential to all acids
adopted from French for the newly identified gas essential to combustion and respiration
stops.meaning: a colorless gas essential to combustion and respiration

current_meaning: a colorless, odorless gas essential to respiration and combustion
